name: Vigrathen
description: Vigrathen is a synthetic adenosine antagonist and SNT-repair compound that eliminates sleep pressure entirely for 60-76 hours by continuously clearing metabolic waste from neural tissue that would otherwise require sleep to process. Cognitive performance remains stable across the entire active window; the compound actively repairs synaptic efficiency in real time rather than deferring it. The crash is physiologically mandatory and catastrophic — the body claims what it's owed.
effects: Complete elimination of sleep need for 60-76 hours
Sustained cognitive performance — no degradation curve
Emotional flatness in hours 48-72 (neurological conservation response)
side_effects: Mandatory crash: 18-22 hours of comatose sleep upon cessation or compound clearance
Dangerous if crash occurs in unsafe environment — user is essentially unconscious and unresponsive
Repeated use causes progressive crash severity
Rare: 'false ceiling' — user believes they are functional in hour 70+ but cognition has silently collapsed
Cardiovascular strain; not recommended with chrome above 30% body integration
duration: 60-76 hours active, followed by mandatory 18-22 hour crash
cultural_context: Vigrathen is the drug of desperation and deadline. the Gray Zone operators use it during gang conflicts when sleep means death. Tier 2 contract workers facing impossible delivery windows use it under the table. Corporate black ops teams used military analogs during the Corridor Wars. Nightshade markets it through proxies with studied deniability. The crash is the real danger — GLMZ's emergency wards see multiple Vigrathen-crash patients weekly, found unconscious in uncontrolled environments.
story_hooks: A the Gray Zone runner who took Vigrathen for a 60-hour job crashes in the middle of an alley — and wakes up 20 hours later to find someone has used their unresponsive body as an unwitting drug mule, surgically inserting a package they were never meant to know about.

Nightshade Pharmatech is testing a second-generation Vigrathen that eliminates the crash entirely — but the human trials on the Gray Zone volunteers are showing that without ever sleeping, the test subjects are losing the ability to feel anything at all.
A Tier 4 executive running on Vigrathen for a hostile acquisition push hits the 'false ceiling' in hour 68 and makes a catastrophic decision they have no memory of — and no legal defense for.
